lines.text: Moses asks his father-in-law Jethro to let him return to his brothers in Egypt, and Jethro says, "Go in peace."
Moses puts his wife and sons on a donkey and heads back to Egypt with the staff of God.
The LORD tells Moses to say that Israel is His firstborn son and that He will kill Pharaoh's firstborn son.
At a lodging place the LORD is about to kill Moses, but his brother Aaron cuts their son with a flint knife.

wrong_details.wrong: his brother Aaron cuts their son with a flint knife
wrong_details.true: Zipporah took a flint knife and circumcised her son

lines.text: Aaron meets Moses at the banks of the Nile, and after Aaron speaks and Moses performs signs, the elders believe and worship.
